notes.title: Version 0.8
notes.content:
[h1]✨ Changes & New Features:[/h1][p][b]🔹 Brand-New UI:[/b]
The entire interface has been rebuilt. Modern, clean, and now featuring your in-game character as a central element – the UI feels much more integrated into the game world.[/p][p][b]🔹 Working Settings Menu:[/b]
It’s finally here – a settings menu that actually works! From volume to controls, you can now adjust your experience to your liking.[/p][p][b]🔹 Savegame Support:[/b]
No more starting over! Your progress is now saved and can be resumed at any time.[/p][p][b]🔹 First Level temporarily moved to Beta:[/b]
The first level has been shifted to the beta branch for now. It will return in the next update with new details and expanded features – stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Version 0.7.1
notes.content:
[h1]✨ Changes & New Features:[/h1][p][b]🔹 Background Video Fix:[/b]
The bug where the menu background video was not playing (showing a black screen instead) has been resolved. The video now plays as intended, enhancing the game’s atmosphere.[/p][p][b]🔹 First Level Improvements:[/b]
The design and gameplay of the first level have been refined. Expect a more immersive environment with improved interactions and flow.[/p][p][b]🔹 Reworked In-Game Menu:[/b]
The in-game menu has been overhauled to offer clearer navigation and a more user-friendly experience.[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.7_Alpha
notes.content:
[h1]✨ Changes & New Features:[/h1][p][b]🔹 New UI Design (Placeholder):[/b]
A new user interface has been implemented – currently in placeholder status. This is a first preview of what’s to come. The final version will be released in a future update.[/p][p][b]🔹 Improved Download & Launch Process:[/b]
An issue that caused problems during downloading or starting the game has been fixed. The game should now install and launch smoothly without any errors.[/p][p][b]🔹 New Sound Effects & Background Music:[/b]
The menu now features atmospheric background music and newly added sound effects, making for a more immersive and polished user experience even before the gameplay starts.[/p]
